name: gamedna-monorepo
description: GameDNA: game-development knowledge, specialist agents and a tested game-code foundation for Kiro.

scripts.build: npm run build:power && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w gravity-shift && npm run build -w neon-survivor && npm run build -w ridgeline-racer && npm run build -w trail-walk
scripts.assets: npm run assets -w gravity-shift && npm run assets -w neon-survivor
scripts.check:power: npm run build:power && git diff --exit-code -- power/kit && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- power/kit)"
